about: What the app relies on inside the Birdsong web page (assets/web/index.html). The app never edits that page: lib/server/local_server.dart adds a little script and CSS when serving it, and lib/server/local_api.dart answers the BirdNET-Go calls it makes. tool/sync_web.py and test/web_contract_test.dart check every new copy of the page against this list. If upstream renames something, change the app's injection (or ask upstream for a proper hook), then update this file.

hooks.used_by: local_server.dart: hidden, closed (no server field in the app)
local_server.dart: padded clear of the menu and mic buttons
local_server.dart: session date, time and place
local_server.dart: watched to re-mark live birds
local_server.dart: wrapped so the session line survives redraws
local_server.dart: markAt default 'below' in listen mode
